title: 公共服务新闻词汇
goal: 识别公共服务词汇并理解服务变更及处理结果。

points.label: 识别公共服务新闻的常用词
听懂服务变更及处理结果

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 公共服务报道通常讲三件事：服务、故障和处理结果。判断词义时，要看动作的对象和事件所处的阶段。

body.box: A damaged pipe closed the pool. Workers repaired it, and the pool reopened.

body.p: damaged pipe 是故障，repaired 是处理，reopened 是恢复开放。

cards.title: 词汇表：服务
rows: The stop is near the park.
Access to the hall is free.
A resident requested a bus stop.

cards.title: 词汇表：故障
rows: The fault affected the heating system.
The power failure closed the hall.
A staff shortage delayed the work.
The bridge was unsafe to use.

cards.title: 词汇表：处理
rows: The pool will reopen on Friday.

body.box: A leak closed the Hilltown pool on Monday. Workers inspected the water system and replaced a broken pipe. The pool reopened on Thursday after staff checked the changing rooms. The town council said the repair had been completed safely. The pool's usual classes will resume next week, and visitors can find the current schedule at the entrance.

body.p: leak 指泄漏，closed 表示关闭。inspected 和 replaced 分别表示检查与更换。reopened 表示泳池已经重新开放。classes will resume 表示课程下周才恢复。

lines.text: A leak in a pipe closed the swimming pool on Monday.

items.why: A leak in a pipe closed the swimming pool 表示水管泄漏导致关闭。

lines.text: Workers repaired the bridge and reopened it to traffic on Friday.

items.why: reopened it to traffic 表示维修后恢复通行。

lines.text: The bus company rerouted its service around the flooded road.

items.stem: What did the bus company do?
options: It suspended its whole bus service.
It closed the road to all traffic.
items.why: rerouted its service 表示改变服务路线。

lines.text: The center suspended classes on Tuesday and plans to resume them on Thursday.

options: Classes will end for the week.
items.why: plans to resume them on Thursday 表示计划恢复课程。

lines.text: A town bus service resumed its usual route on Monday after workers repaired a damaged road. The road had been closed for a week because a water pipe beneath it was leaking. During the closure, buses used a longer route past the railway station, and passengers were advised to allow extra time. Engineers replaced the pipe on Thursday and checked the road surface on Friday. The town reopened the road over the weekend after the inspection was complete. The transport office said all regular stops were now in use again. A temporary stop near the station was removed on Sunday. The office thanked passengers for checking the revised timetable during the disruption. It also said the usual timetable would remain in place for the rest of the month. Residents can obtain a printed copy at the station or view the schedule at the town information desk during normal opening hours.

options: A pipe beneath it was leaking.
items.why: because a water pipe beneath it was leaking 指出关闭原因。

items.stem: What does resumed mean in the report?
items.why: resumed its usual route 表示中断后恢复原路线。

items.stem: The road is closed because a pipe is leaking. What does leaking mean?
items.why: leaking 表示液体从管道中漏出。

items.stem: Workers will repair the damaged door. What will they do?
items.why: repair 表示修理损坏的门。

items.stem: The service will resume on Friday. What will happen?
options: It will be checked on Friday.
It will be delayed on Friday.
It will start again on Friday.
It will be canceled on Friday.

items.stem: The company rerouted the bus around the closed road. What did it change?
options: The path taken by the bus
items.why: reroute 表示改变行进路线。

items.stem: The hall was closed for maintenance. What was the purpose?
options: To keep the hall in working order
To announce a new timetable for the hall
To build a new hall on the site
To resume service at the hall
items.why: maintenance 指维护，目的是保持设施正常运作。

items.stem: The council installed new signs at the station. What did it do?
options: It removed signs from the station.
It put up new signs at the station.
It checked the signs at the station.
It ordered new signs for the station.
items.why: install 表示安装，put up 是同义表达。

lines.text: A city bus route returned to its usual timetable on Monday after a bridge repair was completed. The bridge had closed because an inspection found damage to its surface. Buses used a longer route through the market district during the two-week closure. Workers repaired the surface and engineers inspected it again on Friday. The transport office said all regular stops were now operating. A temporary stop at the market was removed on Sunday. Passengers can obtain the current timetable at the station. The office thanked residents for allowing extra travel time during the disruption.

options: The market district opened to buses.
items.why: an inspection found damage to its surface 指出关闭原因。

items.stem: What happened after the bridge repair?
options: Buses moved through the market district.
Buses returned to the usual timetable.
items.why: returned to its usual timetable ... after a bridge repair was completed 表示维修后的结果。

lines.text: The Northside community pool reopened on Thursday after a leak in its water system was repaired. The pool closed on Monday when staff found water on the changing-room floor. Engineers replaced a damaged pipe and checked the rest of the system on Wednesday. During the closure, swimming classes moved to the school pool nearby. The pool manager said the regular classes would return next week. Public swimming sessions have already resumed at the community pool. The manager added that the opening hours were unchanged and that a schedule was available at reception.

items.stem: What led to the pool closure?
options: A leak in the water system
A move of classes to the school
items.why: after a leak ... was repaired 与 closed ... when staff found water 指出泄漏导致关闭。

items.stem: Which activity has already resumed at the community pool?
items.why: Public swimming sessions have already resumed 表示公众游泳时段已经恢复。
